simple.meaning: יִשְׂרְאֵלִי (Yisrᵉʼêlîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Jisreelite or descendant of Jisrael.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.short: a Jisreelite or descendant of Jisrael
definitions.full: H3481. Yisreeli יִשְׂרְאֵלִי adjective, of a people of foregoing; — masculine ׳הַיִּשׂ Lev 24:10 ; feminine הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית 24:10 ; 24:11 , compare 24:10 . — 2Sam 17:25 < ᵐ5 הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִי, A Th We Dr and others (so || 1Chr 2:19 ).

occurrences.englishText: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.
